notes.title: We’re Officially Entering Production!
notes.content:
Hey new and old friends, 

We’re thrilled to announce that Hack 'n' Stack is officially moving into production! This milestone means we’re closer to bringing you, our game ! 

Hack 'n' Stack wasn’t always as you see today. It started as The Tower, a literal tower defense game with a fun twist. While the concept showed potential, we quickly realized it didn’t quite capture the excitement or depth we wanted to deliver. It felt repetitive, and we knew we could do better. 

So, we pivoted. And wow, what a journey .... Hack 'n' Stack became something much more dynamic and creative. This change wasn’t just a decision, it was a commitment to giving you, our players, a game worth your time. 

What This Means for You: 


We’ve been listening to all your feedback throughout this process. Your support and enthusiasm keep us going, and we’re beyond grateful.  
As production kicks off, we’ll have plenty of opportunities for you to get involved, think beta testing, feedback sessions, and maybe even a chance to shape some of the game’s features! 
Expect regular updates from us with behind-the-scenes looks, development progress, etc. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366533/68e236e0a09d1735bd3979926c0ebbcdb8ef284e.png

Stay tuned, and let’s build this together (literally)! 🧱
